notFoundBody: This registration link is invalid or the tournament no longer exists.
slotsLeft: {count, plural, one {<n>#</n> slot left in the roster.} other {<n>#</n> slots left in the roster.}}
inviteLinkCopiedHint: Share it with the rest of your team.
leaveConfirm: Leave this team? Your registration for this tournament is removed.
leftDeleted: The team had no players left, so it was removed.
closedBody: The bracket is drawn, so teams can no longer sign up. Talk to someone on the crew if this looks wrong.
steamRequiredBody: Sign in with Steam so the organizer can verify who is playing, and so your invite link knows it is you.
signInRequiredBody: Registration is tied to your account, so sign in before entering a team.
joinBody: You have been invited to a team in <name>{tournament}</name>.
createBodySteam: You are creating the team now. The invite link for the rest comes after.
createBodyManual: Enter the whole roster — this tournament is not using Steam sign-up.
errorMinPlayers: {count, plural, one {Minimum # player required} other {Minimum # players required}}
discordHint: So you get a message on Discord when your match is called.
discordFoundBody: You will get a message there when your match is called.
discordBlockedTitle: Found you, but cannot DM you
discordBlockedBody: Turn on direct messages from server members in your Discord settings. The crew comes for you either way.
discordNotFound: Nobody in the Discord server has that name. Check the spelling, or join the server first. You can add it later on Profile.
discordAmbiguous: Several people in the server have a similar name. Type your full Discord name, or add it later on Profile.
discordTaken: That Discord account is already linked to another player. Tell the crew.
discordFailed: Could not check that Discord name right now. You can add it later on Profile.
